source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of creating visualizations (PDF 149).

items: Data likhein, maslan ek column mein mahine aur doosre mein sales.
Cells par click kar ke ghaseet kar data select karein.
Insert tab se chart ki qism chunein (bar chart, line graph waghaira).
Chart sanwarein: title lagayein aur axes par labels, jaise mahine aur sales.
Samjhein ke kya dikhata hai: bar charts mahana sales jaisi qismon ka muwazna, line graphs waqt ke saath rujhan.

blocks.alt: Chhe hisse: Class A aur Class B ke scores ka grouped bar chart, rozana kamai ka line graph jo 500 se 1,300 rupay tak barhta hai, das exam scores ka histogram 50s se 90s ke khanon mein ginti 1, 2, 2, 3, 2, parhai ke ghanton banam marks ka scatterplot dashed best-fit line ke saath, Class A aur Class B ke boxplots, aur chart banane ke spreadsheet qadam.
blocks.caption: Is chapter ke data se paanch qism ke charts (topics 5.5 aur 5.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Bars qismon ka muwazna karte hain, yahan do classes mein har student ka score. Line graph waqt ke saath rujhan dikhata hai, har din barhti kamai. Histogram taqseem dikhata hai: das mein se zyada scores 80s mein hain. Scatterplot rishta dikhata hai: marks parhai ke ghanton ke saath barhte hain, line marks = 14.3 + 6.14 x hours ke qareeb. Boxplots groups ka muwazna karte hain: dono classes ka median 55 hai, magar Class B ka box aur whiskers kahin chaure hain. Excel ya Google Sheets mein data likh kar select karein, chart insert karein, labels lagayein aur phir parhein ke woh kya batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Data visualizations ki qismein aur un ke istemal par baat kijiye (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: Bar charts qismon mein miqdar ka muwazna (product ke hisab se sales). Line graphs waqt ke saath tabdeeli (din ke hisab se darja-e-hararat ya kamai). Histograms ek variable ki khanon mein taqseem (exam scores). Scatterplots do variables ka rishta (ghante aur marks) aur rujhan aur outliers pehchanne mein madad. Boxplots median, quartiles aur outliers se phailao ka khulasa aur groups (classes) ka muwazna. Pie charts kul ke hisse dikhate, aur heatmaps grid mein qeematon ke liye rang istemal karte hain. Durust chart chunne se nukte wazeh aur diyanatdar rehte hain.
